tools.name: search
tools.description: Only use this when the user asks about previous sessions or prior work; where possible run multi-step investigation in a subagent that returns only findings with session ids. Search previous coding-agent messages using PostgreSQL websearch syntax and structured filters. Results contain message windows grouped by session; use session_id and seq with get or sql.

tools.name: get
tools.description: Only use this when the user asks about previous sessions or prior work; where possible run multi-step investigation in a subagent that returns only findings with session ids. Read a session header and messages by session_id. Bound a range with from/to; use next and content_cursor to continue.

tools.name: sql
tools.description: Only use this when the user asks about previous sessions or prior work; where possible run multi-step investigation in a subagent that returns only findings with session ids. Run one read-only PostgreSQL SELECT over api_ro. Views: sessions (session metadata); messages (normalized messages); session_files (observed files); session_observed_commits (commit observations); session_tools (tool counts); users (visible contributors); installations (visible devices); repos (visible repository counts); schema_columns (column descriptions); schema_functions (function descriptions). search_messages(q) returns uncapped session_id,seq,rank. Discover columns with SELECT * FROM schema_columns WHERE view_name = 'sessions'. Limits: 500 rows, 5 seconds.

tools.name: set_visibility
tools.description: Only use this when the user asks about previous sessions or prior work; where possible run multi-step investigation in a subagent that returns only findings with session ids. Change session visibility between PUBLIC and PRIVATE with a reason. Private sessions are visible to organization admins only.

tools.name: purge
tools.description: Only use this when the user asks about previous sessions or prior work; where possible run multi-step investigation in a subagent that returns only findings with session ids. Permanently remove session contents and retain its tombstone. Supply a reason.

tools.name: audit
tools.description: Only use this when the user asks about previous sessions or prior work; where possible run multi-step investigation in a subagent that returns only findings with session ids. Read this organization's audit events using exact identifiers and UTC time bounds.

tools.description: Only use this when the user asks about previous sessions or prior work; where possible run multi-step investigation in a subagent that returns only findings with session ids. Read this organization's ingestion, redaction, and background job status.
